mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM cut_approval_node n JOIN cut_approval_instance i ON i.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND i.id = n.approval_instance_id AND i.deleted = b'0' WHERE n.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND n.current_approver_user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND n.status_code = 'PENDING' AND n.deleted = b'0' AND i.status_code = 'PENDING' AND i.hold_reason_code IS NULL ORDER BY i.create_time ASC, i.id ASC, n.id ASC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}

SELECT n.* FROM cut_approval_node n JOIN cut_approval_instance i ON i.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND i.id = n.approval_instance_id AND i.deleted = b'0' WHERE n.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND n.status_code IN ('WAITING','PENDING') AND n.deleted = b'0' AND i.status_code = 'PENDING' ORDER BY i.create_time ASC, i.id ASC, n.node_no ASC, n.id ASC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
